# Cracktro content rules

Enforced by `docs/tests/talk.spec.ts`. Load before adding public text, data, avatars or images to `deck.js`.

- Everything is public. Use only synthetic examples and role icons, never people. Do not include private repos, `github/<repo>`-style references, 40-hex SHAs, or `who:` fields.
- Never use real GitHub users' avatars, handles or names for people in slides, notes or comments. Humans are the fake users `mona` and `ducky`, GitHub's two mascots, as local files `assets/avatars/{mona,ducky}.jpg` referenced from SVG `<image>` elements. No other avatars or `<image>` sources. Both are clips of official brand.github.com mascot art (modern three-quarter 3D style) on the deck's `#0d1117` background; never generate mascots or use white backgrounds. The one exception is `assets/avatars/mona-full.png`, a transparent full-body cut-out of the same Mona art, used once on the Trust the process slide (`tp-mona`), watching from the left edge.
- Mascot use follows https://brand.github.com/graphic-elements/mascots: Mona is the maintainer; Ducky is the external contributor (community user); a developer can be either, so mix them; use them sparingly, never as logos, and never on serious topics (security, enterprise, money). Use role icons on those slides.
- Exception: the Model routing slide's results panel shows figures measured on gh-aw's own workflows; its speaker notes say so.

The column header says "30 DAYS" and the caption gives both windows; the flows are illustrative and its notes and caption say so.

- Exception: the data slides before the finale. "First commit to GA" (`hist-` classes), shows gh-aw's measured public history (git on main plus GitHub search counts, 12 Aug 2025 to GA on 28 Oct 2026); its speaker notes give the sources and say account attribution is not proof of AI use. "How PRs land" (`land-` classes), shows measured time-to-merge and lines-changed distributions of merged PRs, split by the same origins; issues opened under a person's account may still have been drafted in the Copilot app or CLI, which GitHub does not record. "How workflows evolve" (`evo-` classes), shows measured first-parent commits on main that changed `.github/workflows/**/*.md` (monthly by author type, live workflow count, lines-changed histogram and statistical tests: Spearman, Mann–Whitney, Gini), 12 Aug 2025 to GA; its notes give the method.

The workflow, servers, tool calls, files and pull requests in the flow are synthetic and its notes say so. Refresh with `refresh/cli-vs-mcp.md`.
- The only URLs allowed in `deck.js` are `https://github.github.com/gh-aw/introduction/overview/` and the For PMs source link `https://github.com/chrizbo/agentics-beyond-code`.
- Speaker notes of every slide marked `illustrative` in `slides.md` must match `/illustrative|synthetic|simulated/i`.
- Never write slide numbers or slide counts outside `slides.md`; refer to slides by heading and CSS prefix.
- No external requests and no page errors.
